## Summary

A live-regime observation on his Nasdaq-100 momentum rotation: "These are the times I'm glad I use volatility targeting." With vol elevated, the strategy is currently deploying **about a third of the capital set aside for it** — so pullback losses are proportionally smaller than the strategy's raw signal would imply. The honest cost stated up front: gains were smaller on the way up, too. He tracks the strategy's current open positions publicly at `crackingmarkets.com/ndx-momentum/`.

## Why it matters

- This is the exposure-management half of the momentum-rotation story that the same morning's BolsaCartera backtest pitch ([[2026-11-19-bolsaycartera-ndx-momentum-350-backtests]]) omits entirely: the return stream is `signal × position size`, and the size dial (vol targeting) is what converts a binary backtest equity curve into something survivable. His 1/3-capital-in-high-vol state is the mechanism working as designed — 2022-style drawdown compression in exchange for giving up upside.
- Consistent with his documented publishing ethos — full rules, code, and now a live-positions page ([[2026-09-04-systematicpeter-why-publish-research]]) — the opposite posture of profile-link funnels.
- Skepticism gate: one tweet, no numbers — the claim is checkable against his public positions page, which is exactly what the filed Inbox task does.
